title: Fixed Open Guide Frame and Plunger Stamp
description: One original complete static open-frame plunger desk-stamp appearance. A whole rectangular annular foot, four corner posts and upper guide ring form actual open side windows. A central rectangular plunger supports a broad chamfered top press cap and a lower full stamping platen with a separate blank pad. The pad is fixed raised inside the base opening with visible clearance, not painted onto a solid block. Three opaque untextured PBR roles. One prop and zero scenes. Newly authored geometry, not a narrow stapler or a paired-hole paper punch scaled. No text, logo, identity, official seal, imprint, ink, spring, internal self-inking mechanism, stamping action, instructions, authentication or safety claim; static blank office-tool appearance only.
